query_understanding.normalized_text: HDPE pipes 110mm PN6 rural drinking water Jal Jeevan Mission

primary_recommendation.title: High Density Polyethylene Pipes for Potable Water Supplies — Specification
primary_recommendation.full_title: IS 4984:2016 — High Density Polyethylene Pipes for Potable Water Supplies — Specification (Fifth Revision)
primary_recommendation.scope_snippet: This standard specifies requirements for high density polyethylene (HDPE) pipes made from PE-63, PE-80 and PE-100 material for water supply schemes.

certification.notifying_ministry: Ministry of Chemicals and Petrochemicals / Jal Shakti

allied_standards.title: Thermoplastics Pipes and Fittings — Methods of Test
allied_standards.why: IS 4984 Clause 8 mandates hydrostatic pressure and internal pressure creep testing per IS 12235.

allied_standards.title: Code of Practice for Plastics Pipes Laying and Jointing — HDPE Pipes
allied_standards.why: Jal Jeevan Mission guidelines require trenching, laying, and butt-fusion jointing strictly as per IS 7634 Part 2.

allied_standards.title: Methods of Test for Polyethylene Moulding Materials and Polyethylene Compounds
allied_standards.why: Required for resin carbon black dispersion and density conformance before pipe extrusion.

outdated_citations.reason: Superseded by IS 4984:2016 which introduces PE-100 grade and higher burst pressure criteria.
outdated_citations.message: Draft mentions fourth revision (1995). The current Fifth Revision (2016) must be specified for JJM funding eligibility.

reasoning_trace.detail: Identified product 'HDPE Pipes', size '110mm PN6', domain 'Drinking Water / Jal Jeevan Mission'.
Vector similarity identified IS 4984:2016 (0.97) as the direct potable water standard.
Knowledge graph linked mandatory hydrostatic test suite IS 12235 and site jointing code IS 7634 (Part 2).
Pipes & Fittings QCO 2020 confirms mandatory BIS ISI mark certification.

plain_language_explanation.text: For 110mm PN6 potable water piping under Jal Jeevan Mission, specify **IS 4984:2016** (PE-80 or PE-100 material). The manufacturer must hold a valid BIS ISI License under the Pipes QCO. Field laying must strictly follow IS 7634 Part 2 to prevent joint failures.

compliance_checklist.item: Cite IS 4984:2016 (PE-80 / PE-100) in tender documents
Mandatory BIS ISI Mark on pipe body at 1-meter intervals
compliance_checklist.action_required: Verify marking includes CM/L license number, batch code, and pressure rating.
Include contractor joint inspection certificate clause.

staleness_risk.message: Standard is active and fully compliant with latest QCO notifications.
